notes: Corrected: the accepted alignment crossed s001 and s002, giving כָּל the English *the* and the article הַ the English *All*, with notes carried over from v.66's *The whole assembly*. The ASV here writes *All the Nethinim*, so כֹּל takes *All* and the article takes the *the* standing before its own word.
All other units are unaffected; the rest of the array is reproduced unchanged.
